answer: Reputation Decay Curve. Each identity's influence is capped by cumulative activity score that decays exponentially with dormancy; new identities start at the reef of near-zero reach and must accrue score through verified work. Sybil clusters hit a nadir where marginal identities yield diminishing returns, since shared funding links trigger penalty multipliers. Honest accumulators eventually reach a meadow of stable standing. An attacker pays linear real work per identity while returns collapse exponentially, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
